title: Simple Woodcutter
description: Adds the Tree Feller enchantment for axes. Apply it and breaking a single log will fell the entire tree. Supports all vanilla and modded logs and axes, with three levels of power for small to massive trees.
body: Woodcutter adds the Tree Feller enchantment for axes. Apply it and breaking a single log will fell the entire tree, perfect for efficient logging. Supports all vanilla and modded logs and axes, with three levels of power for small to massive trees.
